name: ediv-portal
buildCommand: cd /opt/render/project/src && pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt && cd backend && python manage.py collectstatic --noinput
startCommand: cd /opt/render/project/src/backend && python manage.py migrate --noinput && python manage.py ensure_admin && python manage.py seed_departments && python manage.py seed_schools && python manage.py seed_users && gunicorn config.wsgi:application --bind 0.0.0.0:$PORT --workers 2 --threads 2 --timeout 180
